title: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters (EMJM)
duration: 1 to 2 academic years (60, 90 or 120 ECTS credits)
description: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters are high-level, integrated transnational study programmes at master's level designed and delivered by international partnerships of higher education institutions. An EMJM involves at least three higher education institutions from at least three different countries, and includes periods of study, research, traineeship, thesis preparation and defence. Each edition runs 1 to 2 academic years (60, 90 or 120 ECTS credits) and awards either a joint degree or multiple degrees. title: ICCR Scholarship (Suborno Jayanti Scheme)
program_type: Government scholarship (500 seats for Bangladesh under Suborno Jayanti)
duration: Up to 3 years for PhD (extendable up to 2 years at discretion of university); varies by programme for UG/PG
description: The Suborno Jayanti Scholarship Scheme is the ICCR scheme for nationals of Bangladesh, subsuming the earlier Bangladesh schemes previously offered by ICCR. Under it, the Government of India through ICCR provides scholarship at UG, PG and Ph.D level in Indian universities. Applications are made online on the ICCR A2A Scholarship Portal and must be submitted through the Indian Mission in the applicant's country, which then forwards them to empanelled Indian State and Central Universities. title: DAAD Scholarship
degree: Mostly Master's/PhD (a few UG-eligible programmes exist but are rare)
duration: 10-24 months for Master's programmes; up to 4 years for PhD (initial award up to 3 years, extendable)
description: The DAAD scholarship database is the German Academic Exchange Service's official listing of its own funding programmes for international students and researchers, together with offers from other selected funding organisations. At the time of verification it returned 150 scholarship options, searchable by country, applicant type, scholarship purpose, subject and programme title. Applications are submitted to the specific programme rather than to a single central DAAD form, and each programme sets its own eligibility, deadline and award conditions. title: Global Korea Scholarship (GKS)
program_type: Government-invited scholarship degree programme (NIIED, Ministry of Education)
duration: Korean language training (1 year) + associate degree (2-3 years), bachelor's degree (4-6 years), master's degree (2 years), doctoral degree (3 years)
description: The Global Korea Scholarship is the Republic of Korea's representative government-invited scholarship programme, administered by the National Institute for International Education (NIIED), which invites outstanding students from around the world to study at Korean universities. It funds Korean language training plus associate degree, bachelor's, master's and doctoral degree programmes across more than 80 GKS universities, and also runs an exchange students programme and Korea-Japan exchange programmes. title: MEXT (Monbukagakusho) Scholarship
degree: UG/PG/PhD - separate application tracks: Undergraduate, Research Student (leads to Master's/PhD), Teacher Training, Japanese Studies, College of Technology
official_source: Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology (MEXT), Japan
program_type: Government scholarship (multiple tracks: Research, Undergraduate, Teacher Training, Japanese Studies, College of Technology, Specialized Training College)
duration: Research Students: 2 years for regular course (6 months preparatory education added if needed). Undergraduate: 5 years including Japanese language training (7 years for medicine/dentistry/pharmacy/veterinary science). Standard: Master's 2 years, Doctoral 3 years (4 years for some fields).
description: The Japanese Government (Monbukagakusho) Scholarship is MEXT's scholarship programme for international students, offered in seven types: Research students, Teacher training students, Undergraduate students, Japanese studies students, College of technology students, Specialized training college students and Young Leaders Program students. There are two application routes: a recommendation from a Japanese embassy or other Japanese diplomatic mission, or a recommendation from a Japanese university. The scholarship pays a monthly stipend, exempts tuition and provides a round-trip travel allowance

title: France Excellence Charpak Scholarship Program
official_source: Campus France India (French Embassy in India)
program_type: Government scholarship (French Embassy in India / Campus France India)
duration: Bachelor's: duration of the bachelor's programme in France. Master's: 1-2 years (renewable once for second year based on results).
description: France Excellence Charpak is the French government scholarship programme in India, divided into four sub-programmes that allow Indian students to study at undergraduate or postgraduate level in public and private institutions in France. title: MOPGA Visiting Fellowship Program
official_source: Campus France (French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs)
program_type: Government research fellowship (French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs, implemented by Campus France)
description: Since 2018 the Make Our Planet Great Again (MOPGA) initiative has been a flagship programme for postdoctoral mobility in France and one of the leading fellowship programmes of the French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs.
